# Banking on AI

> A curated, fully sourced record of AI, machine learning and agentic AI deployments at the world's top 100 pure banks by market capitalisation (December 2024 – November 2026), classified by business segment, with status (Live / Rolling out / Announced), source type and reported benefit for each of the 318 deployments. Refreshed monthly. Curated by Deepanjan Guha.

## Segments

- [AI in Retail Banking](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-retail-banking.html): 39 deployments
- [AI in Private Banking](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-private-banking.html): 15 deployments
- [AI in Corporate Banking](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-corporate-banking.html): 35 deployments
- [AI in Institutional Banking](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-institutional-banking.html): 13 deployments
- [AI in Treasury](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-treasury.html): 14 deployments
- [AI in Trade Finance](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-trade-finance.html): 12 deployments
- [AI in Payments & Remittances](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-payments-remittances.html): 23 deployments
- [AI in Contact Centre](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-contact-centre.html): 56 deployments
- [AI in Enterprise-wide](https://bankingonai.deepanjanguha.work/segment-enterprise-wide.html): 111 deployments
